body.text: The Old Amber revives into Aerodactyl. Mega Evolves into Mega Aerodactyl in later generations, which can be activated with the Aerodactylite.

sections.heading: Playthrough Notes
body: Aerodactyl's exceptional 130 Speed lets it act first against most opponents, and its 105 Attack is strong enough to clean up weakened teams. Aerodactyl is a fast and devestating Rock Slide user, and can boost allies speed with Tailwind.
One of the most generally useful and powerful fossil Pokemon, and a strong choice for any playthrough. Fills the role of Fly HM user as well.

sections.heading: Strengths and Weaknesses
body: Strengths: One of the fastest commonly available playthrough Pokémon. Strong physical Attack. Ground immunity. No evolution wait. Standalone fossil so you dont have to give up something else.

Weaknesses: Weak to Water, Electric, Ice, Rock, and Steel. Physical bulk is only moderate. Its best Rock moves may require a TM or arrive late in some games. Frequently obtained late or after the main story.
